title: GATE/ALPS Students Limited Grade
description: GATE/ALPS Students Limited Grade - Will return students with a GATE/ALPS program limited by grade level. GATE/ALPS is not in Student Special Programs.
code: LIST STU GTE STU.ID STU.LN STU.FN STU.GR? STU.SC? GTE.ESD GTE.PSD IF GTE.ESD # NULL AND ( STU.GR = 3 OR STU.GR = 4 OR STU.GR = 5 OR STU.GR = 6 )
